customers_say: Customers find the water purifier performs better than expected, with top-notch water quality and a premium appearance. They appreciate its ease of use, with one customer noting it's hassle-free, and they like the taste, with one mentioning it makes water sweet and pure. Installation is good, and they consider it a worthwhile investment that saves money in the long run. However, reliability is a concern, with multiple customers reporting it stopped working within a month of use.

And lastly the installation took less than 45 minutes and during the process the installation person was constantly uploading the videos and pics of the RO during installation so its good measure by UC to keep track of how its installed overall. Filtration is Good as expected and pricing justifies the Quality and durability. The 8 Liter storage is good but may not be enough for some househo

reviews.title: Excellent Water Purifier – Native M2 Pro
